description: SLS 8.6 A2 read off one breaker (s8-confluence-v30, 2026-09-14). A2's first-retest Respect and entry-grade Confirmation were read from the best-ranked zone's history while breaker_formed asked whether ANY matching zone was BRK_A, so a MITIGATED breaker under a FRESH OB_A could close A2 on the OB's retest. Unreachable until s6-interaction-v5 gave tail-born zones interactions; 1 of 473 live setups had that stack. Each mutation restores one borrowed link. Deterministic tests, so one battery run is a verdict. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/a2_breaker_history.json

mutations.name: A2's first-retest Respect is read from the best zone again
A2's entry-grade Confirmation and grade are read from the best zone again
mutations.old:
breaker_grade_a=breaker is not None and breaker.grade == "BRK_A",
                breaker_first_retest_respected=breaker_history.first_retest_respected,
                entry_grade_confirmation=breaker_history.confirmed,
